title: Weightlessness Leaves Astronaut Bones Weaker Instead Of Rested
hook: An unprotected Mars mission's estimated hip-bone loss reaches 30%.
closing: Floating removes everyday loading; keeping bones strong becomes part of surviving a long mission.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: The supplied spaceflight estimate is 1.5% bone mineral density loss monthly. It measures weakening density, not bones disappearing.
The hip's monthly density loss reaches 2.2% in these data. Weight-bearing bones lose their usual loading in space.
Unmitigated Mars mission hip loss is estimated at 30%. That is a projection without protection, not an inevitable outcome.
